comparison.objective: Set tiles in a row with 3 mm joints; candidate tunes and locks a compact industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar placement and spacing control versus hex-key insertion, counterholding, controlled collar rotation, torque-limited locking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Tile row with 3 mm joints versus two repeatable safe dynamic stops and retained setting. PR supplies no further tolerance or damage rubric.
comparison.reason: Precision spacing is not damper commissioning; geometry changes cannot bridge the different mechanisms.
